_comment: EXAMPLE TARGET LOCI -- replace with your own.
The mouse Actb locus (mm10 chr5:142,903,115-142,906,754, minus strand;
RefSeq NM_007393.5). Chosen because it is a standard, published positive
control: Tao et al., Nat Commun 14:443 (2023) used 35 pi target probes
against the Actb genomic locus. Coordinates verified against the UCSC
Copy this file to loci.local.json and edit it; loci.local.json is
gitignored, so experiment-specific targets stay out of version control.
start/end are 1-based inclusive, as in UCSC and GenomicInterval.

loci.name: gene_body
loci.description: Actb gene body (positive control, second channel)
